study_design: Prospective multicenter hospital-based case-control study of newly diagnosed prostate cancer cases and controls
reason: The abstract evaluates newly diagnosed prostate cancer overall. It does not report an aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal incident prostate cancer endpoint. Although recruitment is described as prospective, the analytic design compares cases with controls and is not a prospective cohort analysis.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Using data from a prospective multicenter study, serum calcium concentration, as well as thorough demographic and medical characteristics, were determined in 194 cases with newly diagnosed, clinicopathologically confirmed PC and 317 controls, without any malignant disease, admitted to the same network of hospitals.
estimate_classifications.reason: The reported OR compares serum total calcium tertiles for newly diagnosed prostate cancer overall, without an aggressive-disease restriction.
